title: Protestant Religious Education Coordinator - Maxwell AFB
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR EDUCATION AND TRAINING COMMAND.FA3300  42 CONS CC
description_text: This is a solicitation for the provision of Protestant Religious Education Services on Maxwell AFB. Contractor will be responsible for coordinating, teaching, facilitating, and organizing of the Protestant religious education program on Maxwell AFB for ages 1 through adult, IAW the attached Statement of Work. Details regarding instructions to offerors and basis for award are included in the attached SF Form 1449.
